Method of Attack: Arbitrary Code Execution via unsafe string interpolation using dns, url, and script lookups
Impacted Systems: Applications using Apache Commons Text versions 1.5 to 1.9 with unsafe string interpolation
Attack Vector: String interpolation with malicious payloads using the replace function and lookup fields like script, dns, and url
Indicators of Compromise: Use of expressions like '${<lookup field>:<lookup string>}' in application logs or code
